title: HAO shared definitions
description: Definitions reused by more than one HAO part schema. Referenced as hao-common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

idRef.description: An id defined in another part. The runtime registry checks these after assembly; JSON Schema alone cannot.

severity.description: 0 = none, 5 = blocking. An analytical judgement recorded in the dataset, not an ICAO position.

icaoDate.description: ICAO date form: 'Q2 2028', 'Nov 2028' or '2028'. Empty string means not yet set.
